Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

Example:
from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)

```python
from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector
random.seed(21)

scene = Scene("Old timber dormitory")
cream = (.64,.65,.40)
wood = (.23,.135,.065)
iron = (.105,.125,.12)
linen = (.88,.89,.86)
stone = (.40,.38,.29)

def B(name, size, loc, color, parent=scene):
    n = box(size, center=loc, color=color)
    parent.include(name,n)
    return n

def R(name, a, b, radius=.024, color=iron, parent=scene):
    n=rod(radius=radius,start=a,end=b,color=color)
    parent.include(name,n)
    return n

# The wide floor boards run toward the far wall.
B("floor_underlay",(8,12,.12),(0,0,-.105),(.21,.13,.065))
for i in range(27):
    x=-4+i*.30
    start=-6
    j=0
    while start < 5:
        length=random.uniform(1.7,3.4)
        length=min(length,5-start)
        c=random.uniform(.0,.07)
        B("oak_board_%d_%d"%(i,j),(.291,length-.012,.075),
          (x,start+length/2,-.027),
          (.30+c,.19+c*.68,.095+c*.42))
        # Dark nail heads near plank ends.
        for yy in (start+.07,start+length-.07):
            if random.random()<.65:
                for xx in (x-.095,x+.095):
                    R("floor_nail_%d_%d_%s_%s"%(i,j,yy,xx),
                      (xx,yy,.011),(xx,yy,.016),.007,(.10,.085,.065))
        start+=length
        j+=1

B("back_plaster",(7.4,.18,3.5),(0,4.65,1.71),cream)
B("left_plaster",(.18,10.8,3.5),(-3.65,-.65,1.71),(.68,.68,.47))
B("ceiling",(7.4,11,.15),(0,-.7,3.49),(.58,.60,.40))
B("back_skirting",(7.25,.075,.14),(0,4.51,.07),wood)
B("left_skirting",(.07,10.8,.14),(-3.52,-.65,.07),wood)

# Dark exposed framing set into the limewashed left wall.
for y in (-4.1,-2.25,-.45,1.30,3.15,4.48):
    B("upright_"+str(y),(.16,.16,3.46),(-3.51,y,1.72),wood)
for z in (1.12,2.37,3.34):
    B("wall_beam_"+str(z),(.17,10.8,.145),(-3.49,-.65,z),wood)
for y in (-2.4,2.0):
    B("ceiling_crossbeam_"+str(y),(7.25,.20,.24),(0,y,3.33),(.19,.115,.057))

# A bright window on the left, partly concealed by the beds.
B("window_dark_reveal",(.035,1.70,1.65),(-3.539,.15,1.76),(.21,.23,.19))
B("window_daylight",(.042,1.49,1.47),(-3.512,.15,1.77),(.80,.87,.87))
for y in (-.64,.15,.94):
    B("window_mullion_"+str(y),(.07,.055,1.56),(-3.47,y,1.77),(.72,.73,.65))
for z in (1.02,1.77,2.52):
    B("window_rail_"+str(z),(.07,1.65,.065),(-3.47,.15,z),(.73,.74,.66))
B("windowsill",(.24,1.83,.075),(-3.42,.15,.98),(.57,.52,.36))

def bunk(name, x0, x1, y0, y1):
    a=Asset(name)
    # Steel legs with rounded caps and small circular feet.
    for x in (x0,x1):
        for y in (y0,y1):
            R("post_%s_%s"%(x,y),(x,y,.045),(x,y,2.29),.027,iron,a)
            a.include("cap_%s_%s"%(x,y),ball(.031,center=(x,y,2.29),color=iron))
            R("foot_%s_%s"%(x,y),(x,y,.025),(x,y,.045),.067,(.29,.29,.25),a)
    for z in (.47,1.64):
        B("bed_base_"+str(z),(x1-x0,y1-y0,.065),((x0+x1)/2,(y0+y1)/2,z),(.21,.23,.21),a)
        for y in (y0,y1):
            R("long_edge_%s_%s"%(z,y),(x0,y,z+.035),(x1,y,z+.035),.032,iron,a)
            R("lower_rail_%s_%s"%(z,y),(x0,y,z-.085),(x1,y,z-.085),.019,iron,a)
        for x in (x0,x1):
            R("end_edge_%s_%s"%(z,x),(x,y0,z+.035),(x,y1,z+.035),.027,iron,a)
        mattress=fillet_box((x1-x0-.065,y1-y0-.055,.17),radius=.065,
                           center=((x0+x1)/2,(y0+y1)/2,z+.12),color=linen)
        a.include("mattress_"+str(z),mattress)
        B("blue_sheet_edge_"+str(z),(x1-x0-.06,.025,.045),
          ((x0+x1)/2,y0-.014,z+.065),(.38,.48,.62),a)
        # Soft white duvet, with irregular low ridges.
        a.include("duvet_"+str(z),fillet_box((x1-x0-.18,y1-y0-.08,.115),radius=.052,
                  center=((x0+x1)/2+.035,(y0+y1)/2,z+.235),color=(.92,.92,.89)))
        a.include("pillow_"+str(z),fillet_box((.47,y1-y0-.17,.14),radius=.065,
                  center=(x0+.32,(y0+y1)/2,z+.31),color=(.91,.92,.88)))
        for k in range(3):
            ridge=fillet_box((.065,y1-y0-.17,.023),radius=.01,
                            center=(x0+.83+k*.32,(y0+y1)/2,z+.297),
                            color=(.86,.87,.84))
            a.include("linen_fold_%s_%s"%(z,k),ridge)
    # Headboards and footboards; the upper side guard is open steel.
    for x in (x0,x1):
        for z in (.75,.94,1.95,2.12):
            R("end_bar_%s_%s"%(x,z),(x,y0,z),(x,y1,z),.021,iron,a)
        for y in (y0+(y1-y0)*.32,y0+(y1-y0)*.68):
            R("end_spindle_%s_%s"%(x,y),(x,y,1.84),(x,y,2.12),.014,iron,a)
    for y in (y0,y1):
        for z in (1.98,2.13):
            R("guard_%s_%s"%(y,z),(x0,y,z),(x1,y,z),.020,iron,a)
    # Ladder fixed at the open foot of the bunk.
    ly=y0+.09
    for y in (ly,ly+.38):
        R("ladder_upright_"+str(y),(x1+.055,y,.13),(x1+.055,y,1.94),.022,iron,a)
    for z in (.31,.59,.87,1.15,1.43,1.71):
        R("rung_"+str(z),(x1+.063,ly,z),(x1+.063,ly+.38,z),.019,(.27,.29,.27),a)
    # Small historical bed-number plates.
    B("number_plate",(.105,.026,.14),(x1,y0-.031,2.21),(.39,.43,.36),a)
    B("number_mark",(.028,.006,.063),(x1,y0-.048,2.21),(.75,.77,.65),a)
    scene.include(name,a)

bunk("front_left_bunk",-3.38,-.94,-.72,.40)
bunk("rear_left_bunk",-3.38,-.94,1.17,2.25)
bunk("far_left_bunk",-3.38,-.94,2.89,3.93)

# Freestanding narrow oak cupboard on the back wall.
cx=-.55
cy=4.30
cab=Asset("oak_locker")
B("carcass",(.91,.44,1.90),(cx,cy,1.01),(.33,.19,.073),cab)
B("dark_open_interior",(.37,.035,1.64),(cx+.205,cy-.241,1.10),(.105,.071,.037),cab)
B("left_door",(.40,.065,1.78),(cx-.225,cy-.274,1.06),(.37,.225,.085),cab)
for z,h in ((.58,.67),(1.47,.81)):
    B("recessed_panel_"+str(z),(.285,.018,h),(cx-.225,cy-.312,z),(.30,.17,.058),cab)
for x in (cx-.445,cx-.02,cx+.445):
    B("cabinet_stile_"+str(x),(.055,.078,1.90),(x,cy-.27,1.04),(.40,.255,.11),cab)
B("central_shelf",(.43,.42,.045),(cx+.22,cy-.04,.89),(.43,.28,.12),cab)
B("lower_open_panel",(.37,.035,.67),(cx+.22,cy-.23,.47),(.28,.16,.066),cab)
B("top_cornice",(1.04,.56,.075),(cx,cy,2.00),(.39,.25,.11),cab)
B("cornice_upper",(1.10,.59,.035),(cx,cy,2.052),(.43,.29,.13),cab)
B("bottom_moulding",(.99,.51,.075),(cx,cy,.10),(.36,.21,.08),cab)
for x in (cx-.36,cx+.36):
    B("foot_"+str(x),(.12,.34,.12),(x,cy,.055),(.24,.14,.054),cab)
R("door_pull",(cx-.07,cy-.322,.99),(cx-.07,cy-.35,.99),.026,(.11,.095,.055),cab)
R("clothes_rail",(cx+.05,cy-.09,1.83),(cx+.40,cy-.09,1.83),.013,(.26,.25,.19),cab)
for k in range(4):
    xx=cx+.09+k*.075
    R("hanger_left_"+str(k),(xx,cy-.11,1.78),(xx-.05,cy-.11,1.67),.007,(.16,.14,.10),cab)
    R("hanger_right_"+str(k),(xx-.05,cy-.11,1.67),(xx+.06,cy-.11,1.67),.007,(.16,.14,.10),cab)
scene.include("cupboard",cab)

# Small pale circular wall plate above the cupboard.
R("wall_clock_body",(-.40,4.535,2.43),(-.40,4.49,2.43),.115,(.48,.55,.46))
R("clock_face",(-.40,4.485,2.43),(-.40,4.476,2.43),.095,(.63,.68,.58))
R("clock_hand",(-.40,4.465,2.43),(-.40,4.465,2.49),.004,(.27,.32,.28))

# Broad, low, soot-stained stone hearth.
fx=1.48
B("hearth_slab",(2.04,.90,.065),(fx,4.12,.025),(.29,.28,.23))
B("fireplace_black_recess",(1.45,.055,1.20),(fx,4.535,.65),(.075,.068,.050))
# Uneven exposed brickwork at the back of the firebox.
for row in range(9):
    z=.12+row*.115
    for col in range(6):
        x=fx-.64+col*.235+(row%2)*.115
        if x>fx+.66: continue
        v=random.uniform(-.035,.035)
        B("firebrick_%d_%d"%(row,col),(.219,.06,.100),(x,4.483,z),
          (.19+v,.17+v,.125+v))
# Sandstone jambs constructed as separate blocks.
for side in (-1,1):
    for j in range(4):
        B("jamb_%d_%d"%(side,j),(.29,.36,.285),
          (fx+side*.86,4.34,.16+j*.285),
          (.43+random.uniform(-.035,.035),.42+random.uniform(-.025,.025),.33))
# Gently curved lintel: radiating cut stones surrounding the opening.
for k in range(9):
    xoff=-.84+k*.21
    top=1.48+.055*(1-(xoff/.93)**2)
    bottom=1.19+.10*(1-(xoff/.93)**2)
    block=B("lintel_stone_"+str(k),(.207,.37,top-bottom),
            (fx+xoff,4.34,(top+bottom)/2),
            (.46+random.uniform(-.035,.035),.445+random.uniform(-.025,.025),.35))
# Inner rim and old iron grate.
for side in (-1,1):
    R("inner_iron_"+str(side),(fx+side*.67,4.105,.09),(fx+side*.67,4.105,1.12),.018,(.17,.16,.12))
for i in range(8):
    R("grate_"+str(i),(fx-.48+i*.13,4.19,.09),(fx-.48+i*.13,4.19,.28),.012,(.10,.095,.075))
R("grate_front",(fx-.56,4.18,.14),(fx+.52,4.18,.14),.019,(.12,.11,.085))
# Light-colored fire guard leaning beside the opening.
guard=Asset("leaning_fireguard")
for k in range(9):
    xx=fx+.38+k*.031
    R("slat_"+str(k),(xx,4.055,.11),(xx-.09,4.10,.57),.009,(.62,.65,.59),guard)
R("guard_upper",(fx+.29,4.10,.57),(fx+.57,4.10,.57),.016,(.67,.69,.62),guard)
R("guard_bottom",(fx+.38,4.055,.11),(fx+.66,4.055,.11),.012,(.50,.52,.46),guard)
scene.include("fireguard",guard)
R("coal_scuttle",(fx+1.16,4.06,.02),(fx+1.16,4.06,.26),.105,(.10,.115,.10))
R("poker",(fx+1.05,4.17,.04),(fx+1.05,4.17,.65),.011,(.10,.105,.085))
B("small_wall_plate",(.055,.025,.12),(fx+1.04,4.54,1.46),(.31,.32,.24))

# Close cropped bunk at the right edge of the photograph.
bunk("foreground_right_bunk",2.87,5.22,-3.55,-2.42)
B("near_wooden_bed_edge",(.10,.13,3.12),(2.83,-2.54,1.56),(.42,.22,.075))

realize(scene)

# Fine irregularities give the old boards and lime plaster a subdued texture.
for mat in bpy.data.materials:
    mat.use_nodes=True
    nt=mat.node_tree
    bs=nt.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if not bs:
        continue
    col=bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.78
    if col[0] < .18 and col[1] < .19:
        bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=.62
        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.36
    tex=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value=38
    tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value=3
    bump=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.16
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.025
    nt.links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
    nt.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
    if .2 < col[0] < .5 and col[0] > col[1]*1.30:
        tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value=5
        coord=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
        mapping=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
        mapping.operation='MULTIPLY'
        mapping.inputs[1].default_value=(5,.32,5)
        nt.links.new(coord.outputs["Generated"],mapping.inputs[0])
        nt.links.new(mapping.outputs[0],tex.inputs["Vector"])
        ramp=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.18
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(col[0]*.55,col[1]*.55,col[2]*.55,1)
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.82
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(col[0]*1.22,col[1]*1.22,col[2]*1.22,1)
        nt.links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs["Fac"])
        nt.links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])

set_view((3.25,-6.65,1.80),(-.36,2.70,1.43),lens=32,sensor=36)
area_emitter((-3.13,-.10,2.17),power=1050,size=2.4,target=(0,1.0,.7),color=(.91,.95,1.0))
area_emitter((.3,-3.2,3.1),power=260,size=4.0,target=(0,2,1.0),color=(1.0,.91,.74))
area_emitter((1.1,3.4,3.17),power=105,size=2.2,target=(0,2,0),color=(1.0,.94,.78))

world=bpy.context.scene.world
world.use_nodes=True
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value=(.48,.54,.64,1)
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=.23
sc=bpy.context.scene
sc.render.resolution_x=512
sc.render.resolution_y=341
sc.render.resolution_percentage=100
sc.render.engine='CYCLES'
sc.cycles.samples=48
sc.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
sc.view_settings.exposure=.12
```
